headline: Argus Research Maintains Buy on KKR, Raises Price Target to $125
summary: Argus Research  analyst Stephen Biggar   maintains KKR (NYSE:KKR) with a Buy and raises the price target from $115 to $125.

headline: KKR closes record $19.2b infrastructure fund
summary: KKR has raised $19.2 billion for its largest-ever infrastructure fund, with more than $9 billion already committed, including Gulf Data Hub in the Middle East. CNBC's Ritika Gupta reports.
